blocks.text: Aaloodgi ki qism aur shiddat, jaise organic maddah, kimiyai maddey ya jarasim, ke mutabiq mukhtalif safai ke tareeqe use hote hain. Yeh safai ke mukhtalif darjon par use hote hain: primary treatment (tabai malba hatana), secondary treatment (hayatiyati amal) aur tertiary treatment (kimiyai safai). Bare qadam yeh hain.

items: Screening aur sedimentation: pani ko dhaat ki jaliyon (screens) se guzaar kar bare na-hal-pazeer zarrat hataye jate hain. Sedimentation mein pani bare tankon mein rakha jata taake mu'allaq thos kashish-e-saql se neeche baith jayein.

Coagulation aur flocculation: barik colloidal zarrat ko jaldi bithane ke liye zarurat par aluminium sulphate, Al2(SO4)3, jaisa kimiyai coagulant dala jata; ghuli aaloodgi (jaise heavy metals aur phosphates) bhi na-hal-pazeer shakal mein thos ban jati hai. Chhote zarrat jur kar bare dher banate jinhein floc kehte hain, jo aasani se hat jate hain.

Filtration: phir pani darja-ba-darja ret aur bajri ki tahon se guzarta hai, aik mechanical amal jo baqi barik mu'allaq maddah aur kuch khurdbeeni jandaar hatata; ret apne daanon ke darmiyani soorakhon mein zarrat pakarti hai. Zyada behtar safai ke liye activated carbon use hota hai.

Disinfection (jarasim-kushi): filtration ghule ions ya khurdbeeni jarasim nahi hata sakti, is liye kimiyai safai zaruri hai. Chlorination sab se aam tareeqa hai; doosre tareeqe sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), ozone (O3) ya kabhi hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) use karte hain. Chlorine ya sodium hypochlorite pani mein hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banate hain, jo bacteria aur viruses mein ghus kar un ke cell ke kaam bigarta hai.

Reverse osmosis (RO) aur ion exchange: bohat khalis pani, jaise laboratories ke liye, ya bohat namkeen ilaqon mein. RO aik semi-permeable membrane use karta jo dabao mein pani guzarne deti lekin ghule namak, bacteria aur doosri napaki rok leti hai. Ion exchange pani ko 'naram' (soften) karne ke liye hai: sakht pani mein Ca2+ aur Mg2+ ions zyada hote hain jo sanati amal aur sabun mein rukawat daalte, aur ion-exchange column mein yeh ions Na+ ya H+ ions se badal diye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ke teen beakers. Pehle: safed napaki ke zarrat pani mein phaile. Coagulant dala: har napaki se chhota peela coagulant zarra chipka. Flocs baithe: zarrat jur kar floc ban kar tah mein pare hain. Oopar teer par likha: aluminium sulphate jaisa coagulant dalein.
blocks.caption: Coagulation aur flocculation (kitab ki coagulation figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Barik zarrat khud baithne ke liye bohat chhote hain. Coagulant unhein jor kar bhari flocs banata, jo doob jate aur hataye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chhe tank qatar mein, baen taraf gande pani se daen taraf saaf pani tak: screening (khare sarye), coagulation (oopar se kimiyai maddey), flocculation (do paddles), sedimentation (tah mein jama sludge jo hataya jata), filtration (bajri par ret ki tahein) aur disinfection (Cl2, NaOCl ya O3 dala jata). Neeche notes har qadam samjhate aur Cl2 + H2O -> HOCl + HCl dete hain.
blocks.caption: Pani saaf karne ka plant (Figure 33.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har marhala pichhle se chhoti napaki hatata hai: bari cheezein, phir baithne wale thos, phir floc, phir barik zarrat, aur aakhir mein khurdbeeni jandaar.

blocks.alt: Baen: dashed semi-permeable membrane se bata tank; piston namkeen pani ki taraf dabao dalta aur teer pani ka khalis pani ki taraf jana dikhata jab ke narangi namak ke zarrat peeche reh jate. Daen: Na+ wale resin daanon se bhara ion-exchange column; Ca2+ aur Mg2+ wala sakht pani oopar se dakhil aur naram pani neeche se nikalta, equation 2RNa + Ca2+ -> R2Ca + 2Na+ ke saath.
blocks.caption: Reverse osmosis aur ion exchange (topic 33.6 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Reverse osmosis pani ko us ke qudrati bahao ke ulat aisi membrane se dhakelta hai jo namak rokti hai. Ion exchange ions bilkul nahi hatata; yeh sakhti wale ions Ca2+ aur Mg2+ ko Na+ ions se badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki safai mein aluminium sulphate ka kimiyai kirdar kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh coagulant hai: barik colloidal zarrat ko jor kar floc banata hai, jo baith kar hata diya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Aaloodah pani ko mehfooz banane ke liye sirf ubalna ya filtration kafi kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Ubalna zyada tar khurdbeeni jandaar maarta lekin heavy metals jaise ghule kimiyai maddey nahi hatata; filtration mu'allaq maddah hatati lekin ghule ions ya tamam jarasim nahi, is liye disinfection (aur zarurat ho to RO ya ion exchange) bhi use hota hai.

items: Screening, sedimentation, coagulation aur flocculation (Al2(SO4)3), filtration, disinfection (Cl2, NaOCl, O3: HOCl).
RO: dabao mein membrane; ion exchange: Ca2+, Mg2+ ki jagah Na+ ya H+.
